title: India E-commerce Price Tracker input
description: Search Indian e-commerce sources for product price records that can feed competitor price reports, price-history baselines, and product-matching workflows.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Indian e-commerce sources to query. Each source is isolated; blocked sources are skipped without failing the full run. The prefilled first run uses BigBasket with an India residential proxy.

targetProducts.title: Products to compare
targetProducts.description: Optional structured targets for cross-store discovery and matching. Add up to five products. The Actor searches for each target, scores candidate listings, and explains the confidence. When omitted, Search queries remain available for broad discovery.

name.title: Product name
name.description: The product family or exact listing to discover, such as Amul Gold Full Cream Milk.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Optional expected brand. A conflicting known brand lowers confidence.

packSize.title: Pack size
packSize.description: Optional comparable quantity, such as 1 L, 500 g, or 2 x 200 ml.

variant.title: Variant / model
variant.description: Optional distinguishing words such as Gold Full Cream, Toned, 128 GB, or Blue.

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: Broad discovery mode for keywords such as milk, kurti, skincare, or wireless earbuds. Ignored when Products to compare is supplied.

city.title: City / location name
city.description: Used for location-aware sources such as BigBasket, Blinkit, and JioMart.

brands.title: Brand filter
brands.description: Optional exact brand filters for competitor/product matching. Leave empty to keep all brands.

inStockOnly.title: In-stock only
inStockOnly.description: Keep only products clearly marked as in stock.

maxResults.title: Maximum product records
maxResults.description: Maximum clean product records to save across all selected sources. Keep 1 for the first run, use 5-20 for small price-intelligence reports, and increase only for deliberate category monitoring.

maxPagesPerQuery.title: Maximum pages per query
maxPagesPerQuery.description: Limits pagination or scroll payloads per source/query. Keep at 1 for cheap validation and agent calls.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. The prefilled BigBasket run uses an India residential proxy because marketplace responses can be blocked or localized without one.
